---
# The whole of a document's front matter in typst.
#
# Should: run the title, byline and inset abstract on as one flow, set the
# author note at the foot of the first page, and write the contents and the
# lists with no page of their own.
title: "A Document"
shorttitle: "Document"
documentmode: doc
author:
  - name: Ann Author
    corresponding: true
    email: ann@example.edu
    orcid: 0000-0002-1825-0097
    affiliations:
      - name: Test University
  - name: Ben Author
    orcid: 0000-0002-1825-0098
    affiliations:
      - name: Other University
author-note:
  status-changes:
    affiliation-change: "Zqaffiliationchange."
abstract: "Zqabstract text."
impact-statement: "Zqimpact statement."
keywords: [zqone, zqtwo]
list-of-contents: true
list-of-figures: true
format:
  apaquarto-typst: default
---
